info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: API for managing events, categories, enrolments and results. Log in through /api/auth/login first, the session cookie is then used for all other requests.

post.description: Creates an Organiser or Participant account. Expects role (Organiser or Participant), firstName, lastName, email, password (min 8 characters) and an optional contactNumber. The password is hashed before it is saved and the user is logged in straight away.
Checks the email and password. If they are correct a session cookie is created that holds the user's id and role, and the account summary is returned.
Ends the current session by removing the session cookie.

get.description: Returns all age or distance categories that belong to the event. Open to everyone.

post.summary: Add a category to an event
post.description: Creates a category such as Under 20, Senior, 10km or 21km. Expects categoryName and an optional categoryDescription. Only the Organiser who owns the event can do this.

put.description: Changes the name and description of a category. Only the Organiser who owns the event can do this.

delete.description: Removes a category and any enrolments in it. Only the Organiser who owns the event can do this.

post.description: Enrols the logged-in Participant in the chosen category. The link between the participant, the event and the category is saved. No body is needed. Returns 409 if the participant is already in this category or already has another event on the same date. Participant only.

get.description: Returns every event entry of the logged-in Participant with the event and category details. Participant only.

get.summary: List all entries for my event
get.description: Returns every enrolment for an event. Only the Organiser who owns the event can do this.

delete.description: Removes an entry. A Participant can only remove their own entry and an Organiser can only remove entries on their own events.

get.description: Returns all events ordered by date. Open to everyone. Optional query filters: date, location (partial match) and eventType (Run, Walk or Cycle).

post.description: Creates a new event owned by the logged-in Organiser. Expects eventName, eventDescription, eventDate, location, distanceKm and eventType (Run, Walk or Cycle). Organiser only.

get.description: Returns the details of a single event by its id. Open to everyone.

put.description: Updates an event. Only the Organiser who created the event can do this. Same body as creating an event.

delete.description: Deletes an event together with its categories, enrolments and results. Only the Organiser who created the event can do this.

get.description: Returns the profile of the logged-in Organiser. Organiser only.

put.description: Updates the first name, last name and contact number of the logged-in Organiser. Organiser only.

get.description: Returns the profile of the logged-in Participant. Participant only.

put.description: Updates the first name and last name of the logged-in Participant. Participant only.

post.description: Saves the finish time (hh:mm:ss) and optional finishing position for an entry. Only the Organiser who owns the event can do this. Returns 409 if a result was already captured for this entry.

get.description: Returns all results for an event, grouped by category and ordered by finish time. Open to everyone.
Returns the results of one category ordered from the fastest to the slowest finish time. Open to everyone.
Returns the results of the logged-in Participant across all their entries. Participant only.
